lead_fa: Vengeance یک تانک دو-دستهٔ چابک است که با کاهش آسیب کوتاه‌مدت، خوددرمانی و کنترل دشمن بازی می‌کند؛ یکی از دو اسپکی است که بر اساس آسیبِ دریافت‌شده شفا می‌دهد (کنار Blood Death Knight). دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Annihilator]] که در جدول‌های فعلی برای همهٔ حالت‌ها «Best» است و [[Aldrachi Reaver]] با بازی روی Reaver's Glaive و مارک هدف اولویت.

strengths: Powerful opening burst for snap aggro; frequently usable cooldowns
Well-rounded healing and damage reduction; high natural Dodge and Parry
Consistent damage and excellent solo capabilities
Precise and frequent mobility; can cancel knockbacks with Glide
Brings Chaos Brand (unique Demon Hunter debuff increasing enemy magic damage taken)
weaknesses: Multiple defensives that must be juggled rather than one maintained mitigation
Defensives are primarily short duration; need to know when to overlap or chain them
Debuff-based defensives (Fiery Brand, Frailty) require targets to be cast
Healing does not work on environmental damage

healing_changes: Charred Warblades heals for 5% of Fire damage dealt (was 4%); Soul Cleave healing +25%; Fel Devastation healing +25%; Frailty heals 10% of damage dealt (was 8%); Feast of Souls healing +25%; Revel in Pain shields 6% of Fire damage (was 5%)
talent_changes: Sigil of Chains is now baseline at level 35 with a 60s cooldown (was 90s)
Roaring Fire takes the old talent position of Sigil of Chains; Sigil of Silence and Feed the Demon swapped positions; Sigil of Silence now replaces Sigil of Misery when talented
Improved Sigil of Misery now reduces Sigil of Chains by 15s or Sigil of Misery by 30s
changes_12_1.general: A small aura buff: all damage increased by 5.5%.

hero.recommendation: Annihilator carries the (Best) tags across all build tables currently; Aldrachi Reaver remains a strong alternative focused on priority-target damage.
hero.annihilator: Largely passive but rewards correct rotation: every Metamorphosis cast resets Spirit Bomb, so with Apex procs press it immediately after transforming. Optimal rotation currently requires holding some abilities to prevent meteor overlaps (Mass Acceleration bug).
hero.aldrachi_reaver: Focus on uptime of short buffs and killing the priority target. After consuming 20 Souls, the next Throw Glaive becomes Reaver's Glaive; the first Fracture applies a debuff (target takes more melee damage) and the first Soul Cleave procs bonus AoE damage, with doubling depending on cast order. In AoE apply Reaver's Mark to the target that will live longest. Self-sustain via healing buffs.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Vengeance Demon Hunter Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/demon-hunter/vengeance/talent-builds-pve-tank), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Generators are key: both hero trees incentivize keeping Fracture from capping; spenders proc Apex talents but uncapped generators take priority.
Prioritize Souls over Fury: Spirit Bomb is the harder-hitting spender; reach 6 souls as it comes off cooldown, especially before Metamorphosis; then dump Fury to avoid overcapping.
Use your cooldowns: use every ability as it comes off cooldown; short defensive holds are fine but repeated delays lose casts.

st_annihilator: Infernal Strike off GCD if at or near 2 charges and no movement needed soon
Maintain 75 Fury if at 2 stacks of Voidfall or Metamorphosis is about to come off cooldown
Metamorphosis if you will not overcap duration and Spirit Bomb has more than 10s remaining on CD
Fracture if at or near 2 charges
Spirit Bomb with 4+ Souls if Fiery Brand is about to run out
Fiery Brand if the debuff is not currently active
Spirit Bomb with 5+ Souls; if it activated Voidfall, cast Soul Cleave next GCD
Sigil of Spite if you will not overcap Souls
Soul Cleave with 1 or more Souls
Fel Devastation if you have at least 50 Fury
Spend Fury with Soul Cleave at 0 Souls
Fracture if you won't cap Fury or Souls
Felblade if you won't cap Fury
Throw Glaive for filler or when kiting
rotation.annihilator_notes: Goal: never waste cooldowns, Fury, or Souls. Voidfall stacks cycle naturally but Metamorphosis throws it off; hold Metamorphosis a few seconds while meteor animations are still occurring (Mass Acceleration bug). Enter Metamorphosis with maximum Souls to exploit the Spirit Bomb reset.
rotation.aoe_annihilator: Nearly identical to single target with Fel Devastation slightly higher priority; Annihilator effects are primarily passive.
st_aldrachi: Infernal Strike off GCD if at or near 2 charges
Fracture if at or near 2 charges
Fracture with Rending Strike on the priority target to proc Reaver's Mark and generate Souls/Fury
Spirit Bomb with 4+ Souls if Fiery Brand is about to run out
Fiery Brand if the debuff is not active
Soul Cleave with Glaive Flurry to proc Fury of the Aldrachi and trigger Thrill of the Fight
Sigil of Spite to activate Art of the Glaive if no Reaver's Glaive is available
Reaver's Glaive to activate Rending Strike and Glaive Flurry buffs
Soul Cleave with 1 or more Souls
Fel Devastation if at least 50 Fury
Spend Fury with Soul Cleave at 0 Souls
Fracture if you won't cap Fury or Souls
Felblade if you won't cap Fury
Throw Glaive for filler or when kiting
rotation.aldrachi_notes: Soul generation takes priority over everything else in conflicts; uptime is critical due to the constant flow of glaives maintaining buffs.
opener: Precast Sigil of Flame on single target or a single pack
Infernal Strike into the enemy (or the edge of the pack)
Spirit Bomb as you Infernal Strike in if you saved Souls and Fury from the previous pull
Fracture to generate Souls and Fury
Fracture if you won't overcap Souls
Fiery Brand for the Fire damage buff
Fracture if you won't overcap Souls
Felblade to generate Fury if short
Fully channel Fel Devastation for Souls
rotation.cooldowns: Fel Devastation (40s, 28-34s with Darkglare Boon) on cooldown, sync with Fiery Brand if Fiery Demise + Down in Flames; Soul Carver (1 min) with fewer than 3 souls, sync with Fiery Brand if Fiery Demise; Sigil of Spite (1 min) on cooldown, ideally synced with Fiery Brand.

gear.gearing_rules: Take the highest item level item and only compare secondaries at equal ilvl; defensively Item Level >>>> Haste >= Critical Strike = Versatility = Mastery; sim offensively with Raidbots. Get tier slots as quickly as possible.
gear.trinket_note: Zul'jin's Guillotine Technique for raw damage; Lightbearer's Shield Fragment for group defense; Twisted Horror's Tendril and Voracious Heart of Ula'tek as the default pair.

mplus.hero_note: Annihilator builds carry the Best tags in M+ too; Aldrachi Reaver works but needs more uptime management.
tips: Precast Sigil of Flame on a single pack and Infernal Strike into the edge of enemies when tanking.
Save Souls and Fury between pulls: Spirit Bomb right as you Infernal Strike in keeps packs pinned.
Fiery Brand and Frailty need a target; plan them for the biggest hits.
Night Elf (survivability/utility) or Void Elf (damage) for Alliance; Blood Elf is the only Horde option.
